sharedBrief:
Build actual beautiful screens for SOLAR ROOF, a Thai solar rooftop management web app. Thai-language UI. This is a design prototype grounded in existing API contracts, NOT live data. Discreet badge ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง. Cohesive light theme, off-white canvas #F5F7FA, navy typography, emerald/teal primary, amber/red status, Noto Sans Thai fallback, generous whitespace, 12px cards. Editorial clear visual hierarchy. Charts occupy majority of dashboard: readable labeled axes, units, legend, tooltips; no dense row/table dashboards. Sidebar desktop, bottom nav mobile, accessible 44px tap targets.
Shared requirements: range picker with วันนี้/7 วัน/เดือนนี้/กำหนดเอง; sample selected 1–30 ก.ย. 2569, Asia/Bangkok. Site selector defaults every authorized site, searchable. A prominent pan/zoom Thailand map remains VISIBLE in overview AND selected-site detail, containing all authorized sites with selectable pins, plus searchable scrollable site cards; selected site highlighted, กลับทุกไซต์ action. Missing-coordinate sites still listed marked ยังไม่มีพิกัด, no fake pin. Mobile map plus swipeable site cards/bottom sheet; no horizontal page overflow. Selection updates charts/metrics/documents together; date range retained.
Existing sources: stats installedMwp/currentMw/periodKwh/periodAmount; daily production points, site production ranking, site name/code/customerName/capacityMwp/coordinates/status/lastUpdated; availableSites and availableMapSites retain all authorized sites when one selected. Missing/stale/preparing energy values shown —/ข้อมูลไม่ครบ, graph gap, last measured time; never substitute zero. kW/MW = instantaneous power, kWh = period energy, MWp = installed capacity. No fabricated ROI/profit/CO2, energy monetization, import/export or telemetry fields not in contracts.
Finance contract financialInsights: cashReceived (approved payments by TRANSFER date in selected range); cohortBilled/cohortCollected/cohortOutstanding (bills from selected billing cohort); outstanding/overdue/aging (snapshot at asOf, not selected-range cash); pendingReviewCount/settledCount and workQueue. Never label billing as received cash. Use consistent examples: portfolio cohort billed 1,240,000, collected for cohort 1,000,000, cohort outstanding 240,000; cash received in date range 980,000; all outstanding snapshot 320,000, overdue 80,000. Aging sum 320,000 = not due 240,000 + 1–7 days 20,000 + 8–30 30,000 + 31–60 20,000 + >60 10,000. Snapshot caption ณ 9 ต.ค. 2569.
Technical contract maintenanceInsights: gateways/staleGateways/devices/staleDevices/pendingConfigurations/rejectedMessages/comparisonWarnings, attention gateway name/site/lastSeenAt. Selected site devices only name/model/code/profileVersion/interval/lastReceivedAt/lastMeasuredAt/billingSource, gateway protocol/topic/heartbeat/configurationState; no speculative temperature or DC voltage charts.
Documents contract: type invoice/receipt, number, siteName, issueDate, period, amount, status/paymentStatus, documentId. Cards must show date, billing period, payment status distinctly (awaiting payment, pending verification, paid, rejected); preview PDF/download; invoice pay/upload slip. Receipt only after approved payment.
Permissions: admin technician has technical dashboard, NO financial figures or documents; Owner business overview, Accountant same visual family scoped business sites and accounting actions, no technical setup; customer_user only own assigned sites/docs, defaults ทุกไซต์ของฉัน.
Deliver separate named actual screens rather than image collage. Design interaction appearance thoughtfully.
